lead: `nvs-test` has no dependencies on purpose, so a runtime type is unreachable from it.
body: Its `Cargo.toml` carries the reason, which is that a failing runner must not look like the thing it tests failing. A slice asked to route the `.nvst` sections through a runtime type routes them through the `.nvsr` *file* instead, whose one reader is `inbound_from` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`, and names the other writer where the derivation is duplicated.
